parameters.content:
## 1. Start meeting
UI calls **POST /webhook/hagrid-start**. The model secretly decides Hagrid's opening, ceiling and trades (JSON). The UI keeps it hidden and sends it back every turn.

## 2. Chat with Mr Hagrid (streamed)
UI calls **POST /webhook/hagrid-chat**. Replies stream word by word. Memory is per meeting (sessionId).
**Model settings live in the Ollama node** (keep num_ctx = 4096 everywhere, or the model reloads = slow).

## 3. Scorecard
UI calls **POST /webhook/hagrid-score** with the full transcript. A strict coach prompt returns a structured scorecard (JSON).

## 4. Forget a meeting
UI calls **POST /webhook/hagrid-forget** when you delete a past meeting. Wipes that meeting's chat memory (same session key as Meeting Memory, so it hits the same buffer).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, sessionId: $('Get session id').first().json.sessionId } }];
